+++ b/tests/end2end/test_conftest.py
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+"""Tests for end-to-end marker handling."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('webengine', [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('qt_version', ['5.11', '5.12', '5.13', '5.14', '5.15'])
+def test_js_headers_marker(request, monkeypatch, webengine, qt_version):
+    """Skip dynamic headers only on affected QtWebEngine versions."""
+    plugin_path = str(Path(__file__).with_name('conftest.py'))
+    end2end_conftest = request.config.pluginmanager.get_plugin(plugin_path)
+    assert end2end_conftest is not None
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        end2end_conftest.qtutils, 'version_check',
+        lambda version, compiled=False: tuple(map(int, qt_version.split('.')))
+        >= tuple(map(int, version.split('.'))))
+
+    item = mock.Mock()
+    item.get_closest_marker.side_effect = (
+        lambda name: pytest.mark.js_headers.mark if name == 'js_headers'
+        else None)
+    end2end_conftest.pytest_collection_modifyitems(
+        SimpleNamespace(webengine=webengine), [item])
+
+    should_skip = webengine and qt_version in {'5.12', '5.13', '5.14'}
+    assert item.add_marker.call_count == int(should_skip)
